description: This file contains a report module for 'Territory Wise Sales' in ERPNext, including functions to fetch and process sales data by territory.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report, including labels and field options.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and aggregates sales data per territory, including opportunities, quotations, orders, and invoices.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves opportunity records based on filters.

methods.name: get_quotations
methods.description: Retrieves quotation records linked to opportunities.

methods.name: get_sales_orders
methods.description: Retrieves sales order records linked to quotations.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves sales invoice records linked to sales orders.

methods.name: _get_total
methods.description: Calculates total amount from a list of documents.
